intervention: per-token skip/identity-bypass of whole layers (factory replacement of train_depth_ar.DepthARModel)

train.optimizer: AdamW(wd=0.01) + warmup 200 steps + cosine to 0.1x (shared train())

data.split: first 90M train / last 10M eval, vocab from full file

skip_semantics.definition: skipped layer output for that token = its input (identity bypass, causal-preserving); implemented as out = where(skip_mask[B,T,1], x, block_out)
skip_semantics.layer_passes_per_token: number of non-skipped layers that token actually traverses; averaged over tokens
skip_semantics.implementation: experiment-local SkipBlock wraps each stock Block; factory replaces train_depth_ar.DepthARModel

arms.role: fixed skip of the two middle layers (human layers 4,5), all tokens, train=eval distribution
same-budget fixed-depth opponent: train a 6-layer dense model directly
per-token per-layer independent Bernoulli(0.1) bypass, train=eval distribution

eval.metric: clean bpc = final-depth readout, sequence-level, lower better

criteria.delta_sign_convention: delta(x vs y) = bpc_y - bpc_x; positive = x better
criteria.rate_metrics: paired bootstrap / Wilson 95% CI, do not borrow 0.014
